web-development.description: We create modern web applications that drive business growth – from responsive corporate websites to advanced SaaS platforms. Using the latest frameworks to ensure speed, security, and excellent user experience.
features: React, Vue, Angular applications with optimal performance
Node.js, Python, PHP backends – scalable and secure
Progressive Web Apps (PWA) working offline
Fully responsive design for all devices
RESTful/GraphQL API development and integration
SEO and Core Web Vitals optimization

mobile-development.description: We develop mobile applications that users love to use every day. Native solutions for iOS and Android or cross-platform with React Native.
features: Native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) apps
Cross-platform React Native and Flutter apps
Integration with APIs, databases, and cloud services
App Store and Google Play optimization (ASO)
Push notifications, analytics, and deep linking
In-app payments and third-party integrations

software-development.description: We deliver dedicated enterprise-grade software solutions that optimize business processes and increase operational efficiency. From CRM/ERP systems to automation tools – each solution tailored to your needs.
features: Enterprise software systems (CRM, ERP, WMS)
Process automation and workflow management
Legacy system and external API integrations

ecommerce-development.description: We build online stores that sell and grow with your business. Full-featured e-commerce platforms with product management, payments, shipping, and detailed analytics – all in one place.
features: Custom e-commerce platforms tailored to your industry
Payment gateway integration (Stripe, PayPal, Przelewy24)
Warehouse management systems (WMS) and supplier integrations
Order tracking, sales analytics, and reporting

ai-integrations.description: Harness the power of artificial intelligence to automate processes, reduce costs, and increase team productivity. We create intelligent agents, chatbots, and generative AI solutions tailored to your business specifics.
features: Business process automation with AI
Intelligent chatbots and virtual assistants for customers
ML model integration with existing systems

legacy-refactoring.description: We modernize outdated legacy systems, eliminating technical debt and preparing your application for the future. Increasing performance, security, and maintainability without risking loss of critical business functionality.
features: Code modernization – refactoring to clean patterns
Architecture restructuring (monolith → microservices)
Technology stack upgrades to current versions
Performance optimization and infrastructure cost reduction
Complete technical documentation and test coverage
Data migration and backward compatibility preservation

discord-bots.description: We create advanced Discord bots that automate server management, increase community engagement, and deliver unique features. From moderation to games and external service integrations – everything tailored to your server.
features: Custom command development and slash command interactions
Moderation automation – filters, warnings, bans
User engagement features (leveling, ranks, events)
External API integration (Discord API, REST, WebSocket)
Music bots, games, and entertainment for the community
Web dashboard for bot management

telegram-bots.description: We develop intelligent Telegram bots for customer support automation, business processes, and user communication. Payments, notifications, multi-language support, and advanced inline keyboards – all in one bot.
features: Custom Telegram clients (MTProto, TDLib)
Customer support automation and FAQ chatbots
Payment processing integration (Telegram Payments, Stripe)
Inline keyboards, menus, and interactive forms
File, media, and document handling
Multi-language support and localization
Webhooks and CRM/ERP integrations

signal-bots.description: We build secure Signal bots with the highest level of privacy and end-to-end encryption. Ideal for internal corporate communication, notifications, and automation where data security is a priority.
features: End-to-end encryption preserved in all communication
Automated responses and chatbots with business rules
Group management and administrator features
Privacy-focused integrations (no tracking)
Secure notifications and real-time alerts
Self-hosted deployment for full control

blockchain-development.description: Comprehensive blockchain development services – from Web3 applications and multi-chain wallet integrations to smart contracts and decentralized DeFi platforms. We support Ethereum, Solana, Cosmos, and other blockchain networks.
features: Web3 authentication systems
Multi-chain wallet integrations (MetaMask, Phantom, WalletConnect)
Smart contracts (Solidity, Rust)
DeFi (staking, lending, AMM)
Token standards (ERC-20, SPL) and tokenomics

hosting-solutions.description: We provide comprehensive hosting solutions tailored to your application's actual requirements – from shared hosting to enterprise cloud infrastructure. We guarantee 99.9% uptime and constant technical support.
features: Cloud hosting (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) with auto-scaling
Hosting space – full control and performance
CDN implementation (Cloudflare, AWS CloudFront) for global reach
24/7 monitoring and incident alerts

performance-optimization.description: Comprehensive application performance analysis and optimization – we identify bottlenecks, speed up loading, and reduce infrastructure costs. Increase conversion with a faster website and better Core Web Vitals.
features: Website speed optimization (PageSpeed, Lighthouse 90+)
Database performance tuning (indexing, query optimization)
Code optimization and refactoring (code splitting, lazy loading)
Caching implementation (Redis, Memcached, CDN)
Load balancing configuration and horizontal scaling
Core Web Vitals analysis and SEO improvement

migrations.description: Safe and efficient platform, database, and infrastructure migrations without application downtime. Full support at every stage – from analysis through migration to data integrity verification.
features: Database migrations with full integrity preservation
Application modernization and framework upgrades
Legacy system upgrades without service interruption
Data migration and validation (ETL processes)
Rollback plan and disaster recovery strategy

maintenance-support.description: Keep your applications running smoothly with our comprehensive maintenance and support services.
features: 24/7 monitoring and support
Regular security updates
Bug fixes and patches
Performance monitoring
Backup and disaster recovery

website-chatbots.description: Deploy intelligent AI chatbots on your website to provide 24/7 customer support, answer FAQs, qualify leads, and enhance user engagement. Powered by cutting-edge AI models and trained on your specific business data.
features: 24/7 automated customer support without human intervention
Natural language understanding with context awareness
Lead qualification and automatic CRM integration
Custom training on your company's knowledge base
Multi-language support for global audiences
Analytics dashboard with conversation insights
Seamless handoff to human agents when needed
